facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: hazard report - electrical exposure at TX-3002

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on TX-3002 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically working live under a documented justification. TX-3002 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 22 March 2015 a hazard report was recorded on TX-3002 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a breakdown response; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
